basic_details.job_title: JIIT Security Supervisor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology (JIIT), a private deemed university and not a government employer, wants Security Supervisors for its university campus. Candidates should email their CV with supporting documents to [email protected], and the last date to apply is 30 October 2026. The notice asks for graduates aged up to 45 years with at least 10 years of security or patrolling experience. It gives preference to retired defence personnel.

content_sections.heading: About JIIT Security Supervisors
content_sections.text: The notice is titled "Hiring of Security Supervisors – University Campus", is dated 15 October 2026, and takes applications at the JIIT careers address on the jiit.ac.in domain. Jaypee Institute of Information Technology is a private deemed university based in Noida. The Security Supervisors will handle patrolling and vigilance duties on the campus.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: JIIT takes applications for the Security Supervisor post only by email. The notice sets these steps: Prepare your CV and the supporting documents. Email them to [email protected] . Write the position you are applying for in the subject of the email (Security Supervisor). Send the email by 30 October 2026, the last date to apply.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Security Supervisor. It does not print a number of vacancies, so this article counts it as 1. Pay is "As per University Norms". The notice gives no figure or pay level. The notice lists these qualifications and requirements: Education: Graduates. Age: Max 45 years. Experience: Minimum 10 years of proven security or patrolling experience. Preference: Preference for retired defence personnel. Physical Fitness: Ability to stand or walk for long periods and work in varying weather conditions and rotating shifts. Skills: Strong observation skills, basic incident de-escalation/resolution, and clear verbal communication. For the full eligibility of the Security Supervisor post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: JIIT Security Supervisors Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the job as patrolling and vigilance duties on the campus: Conduct Patrols: Walk assigned routes and locations to inspect perimeters, buildings, parking lots and entry points. Inspection of premises: Check gates and boundary walls/fences for damage, and make sure the security lighting works. Monitoring: When a hazard or safety violation is found, start corrective action. Campus Access: Check visitor credentials and look out for trespassers or unauthorised access. Quick Response: Act as a first responder during incidents, alarms or medical incidents.
